ctaHeading: Williamstown's concrete polish specialists are ready for your project.
aboutText: Based in Williamstown, Tesmer Concrete Polish and Design is operated by Marco Tesmer, a traditional craftsman dedicated to achieving the highest quality in concrete polishing and design. We value our customer relationships as key to long-term cooperation, upholding high work ethics and meticulous attention to detail. At Tesmer Concrete, quality is always in fashion, guiding our actions to provide you with an outstanding and dependable concrete product.
servicesText: At Tesmer Concrete, we specialise in concrete polishing and design services across Williamstown and Melbourne. Our offerings include high-quality finishes for residential and commercial projects, ensuring durability and aesthetic appeal for builders and designers alike.

services.title: Concrete Polishing
services.desc: We polish concrete surfaces to a high-gloss finish, enhancing durability and aesthetics for floors in homes and businesses.

services.title: Concrete Design
services.desc: Custom concrete designs tailored to your specifications, creating unique and stylish elements for any space.

services.title: Stamped Concrete
services.desc: Decorative stamped concrete that mimics natural materials like stone or brick, perfect for patios and driveways.

services.title: Exposed Aggregate
services.desc: Exposed aggregate finishes that reveal the natural beauty of stone, ideal for outdoor areas and pathways.

services.title: Concrete Sealing
services.desc: Professional sealing to protect concrete surfaces from stains and weather, extending their lifespan.

services.title: Decorative Concrete
services.desc: A range of decorative techniques including staining and scoring to add colour and pattern to concrete.
